question: 各个品类的库存分布如何
gold_sql: select c.category_name, sum(p.stock) from products p left join categories c on p.category_id = c.category_id group by c.category_name
raw_output:
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count, SUM(p.stock) AS total_stock, AVG(p.stock) AS avg_stock
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY total_stock DESC;
pred_sql:
